title: eat shit & die 167
author: bpatrick
body: I almost got it done in one day – so close. New readers don’t seem to like Onan but here’s a new one by request of the faithful. Tons of fun to draw. This one actually builds on the last episode. The next two or three Onans should continue this little arc. I’ve only been on vacation two days and I’ve managed two updates! I’m caught in a comic-making mania!

comments.author: David
comments.text: Problem is you don’t make anything bad, so there’s nothing not to request. Would love to see more Curious Urgency and Vivian Blank too.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Onan! Wicked. I love these. And while i’m here, Happy New Year!

comments.author: DarkCanuck
comments.text:
New reader here, I’ve managed to go through most of your archive today and I think that the Onans might be my favourite stuff. I love the tribute to Alien in this page.
Keep up the great work!

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: @DarkCanuck: Thanks! I like the Onans too. And thanks for noticing the Alien allusion.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: another new reader, jumped over from subnormality. I’d read an entire graphic novel of Onan. He’s like the guy I pretended to be when I was a kid each night as I fell asleep.

comments.author: Anonymous
comments.text: I’m really loving these characters. Their adventure fits perfectly with Röyksopp’s “Forsaken Cowboy” which I’m playing in the background.
